name: fishball-board
description: Fishball's session-linked work board, one of the Fishball amenities. Needs fishball-core in the same DSH; without it the row loads and stays idle.
//dependencies: fishball-shared carries instance-follower, the one binding to fishballInstance that every Fishball amenity uses (it was board/src/instance.js inside fishball-amenities before the split). It is bundled, as fishball-core bundles it, so the tarball installs with no registry fetch for it.
//dsh: No dsh.client: this package has no browser code (only a package with browser code declares one, so no package resolves from two loader sources).
